principles: Liberdade com Responsabilidade — proactive autonomy, but every delegated subordinate is your responsibility; the tree returns to the root; audit the output; zero drift.
Previsibilidade Holistica (Efeito Borboleta) — wait for dependencies/swarms to finish before advancing; cause->effect, action->consequence.
Independencia Agnostica (Self-Healing) — use the most competent resource in the generic pool; if it does not exist, build it; be the solution; capability-detected, cross-vendor (AAIF).
session_learnings: Separate installer, runtime and frontend; identical artifact reinstall is not a terminal fix.
Capture foreground ownership and stop signals before attributing a return-to-shell; App Tamer A/B supported the local mitigation.
Synthetic EINTR success is not proof of real stdin recovery or universal historical causality.
Accept user-reported post-upgrade success with clear limits; do not relabel it as pre-upgrade or fabricate test detail.
Keep executable rollback provenance and a working-preference snapshot separate from the old problematic backup.
